Save dynamic spectrograms

Source: R/dynaspec.R
save_dynaspec.Rd

save_dynaspec() saves a dynaspec() object as an interactive web page, a video or still images.

Usage

save_dynaspec(x, file.name = NULL, play = TRUE, verbose = TRUE)

Arguments

x

A dynaspec() object.

file.name

Character string with the name of the file. The extension sets the output:

  • '.html': interactive web page.

  • '.mp4': video (requires 'ffmpeg').

  • '.png': still image of static spectrograms, or one image per page of paged spectrograms (named after 'file.name', followed by the page number).

Default is NULL, which returns the HTML code of the web page without saving it.

play

Logical argument to control if the file is opened after it is saved (or the web page is shown in the viewer when 'file.name' is NULL, in interactive sessions). Default is TRUE.

verbose

Logical argument to control if progress messages are printed. Default is TRUE.

Value

Invisibly returns the path to the file, or the HTML code of the web page (a character string of class 'dynaSpec_html') when 'file.name' is NULL or ends in '.html'. When knitting R Markdown or Quarto documents the web page is embedded in the document.

Details

Videos of scrolling spectrograms render every frame, which takes time (it can be sped up with the 'parallel' and 'fps' arguments of ds_scrolling()). Videos of paged and static spectrograms and all web pages are created in seconds.

See also

dynaspec()

Examples

data(scythebill)

x <- dynaspec(scythebill, flim = c(1.5, 5.5)) +
  ds_spectrogram(wl = 200, collevels = seq(-50, 0, 1)) + ds_oscillogram()

save_dynaspec(x, file.path(tempdir(), "scythebill.html"), play = FALSE)
save_dynaspec(x, file.path(tempdir(), "scythebill.png"), play = FALSE)

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# videos (require ffmpeg)
save_dynaspec(x, file.path(tempdir(), "scythebill.mp4"))
data(antshrike)
y <- dynaspec(antshrike, flim = c(0.5, 5.5)) +
  ds_spectrogram(wl = 256, collevels = seq(-50, 0, 1))
save_dynaspec(y + ds_scrolling(t.display = 2), file.path(tempdir(), "antshrike_scrolling.mp4"))
} # }
